title: Chorus Combat
description: Adds more uses to chorus fruit, and the end!
body:
This mod adds combat weapons and stuff relating to the chorus fruit found in the end.


<details>
<summary>Chorus Sword</summary>
  The Chorus Sword is stronger than the Netherite Sword, and has intresting abilities.

  
<details>
<summary>Why is it unbreakable?</summary>
  The Chorus Sword is unbreakable and is stronger than the Netherite sword, however it still has "durability". It has a Chorus meter that goes down every time you use it, to reduce the amount it goes down by, use the unbreaking enchantment. The max amount of chorus a sword can have is 24, this means if you have unbreaking 3 you can use it 24 times.
<details>
<summary>How do I repair it?</summary>

To repair the Chorus Sword, right click on a Chorus Flower.

</details>
</details>


<details>
<summary>How do I craft it?</summary>

To make a Chorus Sword, right click a age 5 Chorus Flower with a Diamond Sword.

</details>


<details>
<summary>How do I use it?</summary>

There are 2 ways to use the Chorus Sword.
The first way to use it is to simply attack an enemy, once you do that enemy will be teleported as if they ate a chorus fruit.\
The second way to use it is to **EAT IT**, which will teleport you like a chorus fruit would.

</details>



</details>

MORE COMING SOON.
